name: crash-scene-3d
description: Turn a driver's account of a car crash into a 3D illustration on real OpenStreetMap roads, with a small fixed physics model and PDF/PNG/scene exports made in the browser. TypeScript, React, three.js.

paragraphs: A browser tool that turns a driver's account of a car crash into a 3D illustration on the real road layout from OpenStreetMap. The claimant enters the place, the vehicles, their directions and speeds, and where each one was hit; a small, fixed physics model shows the vehicles arriving, touching and coming to rest. The PDF, pictures and scene file are all made in the browser, and every one of them says it illustrates what the claimant described and does not decide fault.
Live demo · T-bone example · TypeScript · React · three.js · OpenStreetMap · MIT license
Recorded from a local fixtures build (VITEFIXTURES=1) with synthetic data: a made-up claim on real public roads in Nashua, NH, with synthetic car photos and 3D models. Illustration only. MP4 version
